translation: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Grantor of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٢٤
translation: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Producer, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَٰرَةࣲ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ ۝١٠
translation: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?

arabic: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝١١
translation: [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.

arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةࣰ فِي جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنࣲۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ۝١٢
translation: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.

arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَاۖ نَصْرࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحࣱ قَرِيبࣱۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٣
translation: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۝١٠
translation: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٣
translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمࣱ ۝١١
translation: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۝١٣
translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرࣰا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ ۝١٦
translation: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا ۝٥
translation: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءࣲ قَدِيرٌ ۝١
translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلࣰاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢
translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝١٣
translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١٤
translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولࣰا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ۝١٥
translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمࣲ ۝٤
translation: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٣٤
translation: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ ۝٢٤
translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ ۝٢٣
translation: Those who are constant in their prayer

arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰا ۝١٠
translation: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارࣰا ۝١١
translation: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرࣰا ۝١٢
translation: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلࣰا ۝٨
translation: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلࣰا ۝٩
translation: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ ۝١٧
translation: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

arabic: عَيْنࣰا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرࣰا ۝٦
translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُورًا ۝٩
translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةࣰ وَحَرِيرࣰا ۝١٢
translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا ۝٢٢
translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ ۝٤١
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝٤٤
translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١
translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ ۝٤٠
translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٤١
translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ ۝٢٢
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

arabic: عَيْنࣰا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۝٢٨
translation: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونِۭ ۝٢٥
translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝١١
translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ ۝١٤
translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى ۝١
translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤
translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥
translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝١٦
translation: But you prefer the worldly life,

arabic: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرࣱ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۝١٧
translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

arabic: وُجُوهࣱ يَوْمَئِذࣲ نَّاعِمَةࣱ ۝٨
translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةࣱ ۝٩
translation: With their effort [they are] satisfied

arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةࣲ ۝١٠
translation: In an elevated garden,

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ ۝١٤
translation: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ۝٢٧
translation: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

arabic: ٱرْجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةࣰ مَّرْضِيَّةࣰ ۝٢٨
translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

arabic: فَٱدْخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي ۝٢٩
translation: And enter among My [righteous] servants

arabic: وَٱدْخُلِي جَنَّتِي ۝٣٠
translation: And enter My Paradise."

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ۝٩
translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ۝٥
translation: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۝٦
translation: And believes in the best [reward].

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ۝٧
translation: We will ease him toward ease.

arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ۝٣
translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

arabic: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٤
translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ ۝٥
translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ۝١١
translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝٥
translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرࣰا ۝٦
translation: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ ۝٧
translation: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب ۝٨
translation: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمࣲ ۝٤
translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونࣲ ۝٦
translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ۝١
translation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created –

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ ۝٣
translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

arabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ ۝٤
translation: Who taught by the pen –

arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ ۝٥
translation: Taught man that which he knew not.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ ۝٧
translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرࣰا يَرَهُۥ ۝٧
translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ۝٦
translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةࣲ رَّاضِيَةࣲ ۝٧
translation: He will be in a pleasant life.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١
translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢
translation: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ ۝٦
translation: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا ۝٣
translation: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١
translation: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝٢
translation: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.

arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣
translation: He neither begets nor is born,

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ ۝٤
translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝١
translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝١
translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
